title: Exercise
description: One entry in the local exercise library. Mirrors the columns in seed-data/strongman_exercise_database.csv.

id.description: Stable identifier. For seed exercises this is the CSV Exercise ID (e.g. "EX001"); custom exercises get a generated UUID.

muscle_groups.description: Split from the CSV's "Muscle Group(s)" column (e.g. "Shoulders & Upper Back" -> ["Shoulders", "Upper Back"]).

measurement_type.description: Drives which input fields the session-logging screen shows for this exercise.

is_custom.description: True for user-created exercises (e.g. from an unmatched spreadsheet import row), false for seed-library exercises.
